content.definition: Component of entity that has been disposed of or classified as held for sale and represents strategic shift with major effect on operations and financial results

qualifying_criteria.component_of_entity: Operations and cash flows clearly distinguishable from rest of entity
qualifying_criteria.strategic_shift: Disposal represents strategic shift that has (or will have) major effect on entity's operations and financial results
examples_of_strategic_shift: Disposal of major line of business
Disposal of major equity method investment
Disposal of major business unit or product line

classification_triggers.disposal: Component has been disposed of (sold, abandoned, spun off)
classification_triggers.held_for_sale: Component classified as held for sale (meets held-for-sale criteria per ASC 360)
classification_triggers.timing: Classify as discontinued in period disposal occurs or held-for-sale criteria met

income_statement_presentation.separate_section: Present discontinued operations in separate section AFTER income from continuing operations

two_components.results_of_operations: Income or loss from operations of discontinued component (from beginning of year to disposal/classification date)
two_components.gain_loss_on_disposal: Gain or loss on disposal of component (or impairment loss if held for sale)

income_statement_presentation.format:
Income from continuing operations (before tax)
Income tax expense
Income from continuing operations (after tax)

Discontinued operations:
  Loss from operations of discontinued component $(XX)
  Loss on disposal of component (XX)
  Income tax benefit XX
Loss from discontinued operations, net of tax (XX)

Net income $XXX
income_statement_presentation.net_of_tax: Discontinued operations reported NET OF TAX (calculate tax effect separately)
income_statement_presentation.earnings_per_share: Disclose EPS for continuing operations AND discontinued operations separately

measurement.if_disposed: Measure at actual proceeds received less costs to sell
measurement.if_held_for_sale: Measure at LOWER OF carrying amount or fair value less cost to sell. Recognize impairment loss if FV-cost to sell < carrying amount.
measurement.subsequent_adjustments: Adjustments to prior estimates of gain/loss included in discontinued operations in current period

ongoing_involvement.if_significant_ongoing_involvement: May NOT qualify as discontinued operation if entity has significant continuing involvement in operations after disposal

calculation_example_1.facts: Company disposes of Western Division (meets discontinued ops criteria) on Oct 1, Year 3. Jan-Sept operating loss $200K. Disposal proceeds $1M, carrying amount $1.2M (loss $200K). Tax rate 30%.
calculation_example_1.income_statement:
Discontinued operations:
  Loss from operations of Western Division $(200,000)
  Loss on disposal of Western Division (200,000)
  Income tax benefit 120,000
Loss from discontinued operations, net of tax $(280,000)

calculation_example_2_held_for_sale.facts: Eastern Division classified as held for sale on Dec 1, Year 3. Operating income Jan-Nov $300K. Carrying amount $2M, FV $1.8M, cost to sell $100K. Tax rate 30%.
calculation_example_2_held_for_sale.income_statement:
Discontinued operations:
  Income from operations of Eastern Division $300,000
  Impairment loss on Eastern Division (300,000)
  Income tax expense (benefit) 0
Income from discontinued operations, net of tax $0

comparative_statements.prior_periods: Restate prior period financial statements to separately present discontinued operations
comparative_statements.continuing_operations: Prior periods restated to show only continuing operations in main income statement
comparative_statements.note: All periods presented must reclassify discontinued component results to separate section

disposal_groups.definition: Group of assets (and liabilities) to be disposed of together in single transaction
disposal_groups.classification: If meets discontinued ops criteria, present as discontinued. Otherwise, may be held for sale (disclosed) but not discontinued operations.

balance_sheet_presentation.assets_held_for_sale: Present separately on balance sheet (current assets if disposal expected within one year)
balance_sheet_presentation.liabilities_held_for_sale: Present separately if disposal group includes liabilities
balance_sheet_presentation.no_offsetting: Assets and liabilities of disposal group not offset (show separately)

cpa_exam_tips: Discontinued ops requires BOTH: (1) component disposal AND (2) strategic shift with major effect
Present discontinued ops AFTER income from continuing operations
Discontinued ops shown NET OF TAX
Two components: (1) Operating results, (2) Gain/loss on disposal (or impairment)
If held for sale: Impairment = Carrying amount - (FV - cost to sell), if positive
Restate prior periods to reclassify discontinued component
Don't confuse with held-for-sale classification (held for sale ≠ discontinued unless also strategic shift)

qualification_checklist: ✓ Component with distinct operations and cash flows?
✓ Major effect on operations and financial results?
calculation_approach: 1. Calculate operating income/loss from discontinued component (beginning of year to disposal date)
2. Calculate gain/loss on disposal (proceeds - carrying amount) OR impairment (CA - (FV - cost to sell))
3. Calculate tax effect on each component separately
4. Present net of tax in discontinued operations section
cpa_exam_strategies.presentation_template:
Income from continuing operations (after tax) $XXX

Discontinued operations:
  Income (loss) from operations $(XX)
  Gain (loss) on disposal (XX)
  Tax expense (benefit) XX
Income (loss) from discontinued operations XX

Net income $XXX
common_mistakes: Forgetting to calculate separate tax effects for discontinued ops
Not checking for 'strategic shift' requirement (component disposal alone not sufficient)
Confusing held-for-sale (balance sheet classification) with discontinued operations (income statement classification)

key_points: Discontinued ops = Component disposal representing strategic shift with major effect
Present in separate section AFTER continuing operations, NET OF TAX
Two components: (1) Operating results, (2) Disposal gain/loss or impairment
If held for sale: Lower of CA or FV less cost to sell (recognize impairment if needed)
Restate prior periods to reclassify discontinued component
Separate EPS disclosure for continuing and discontinued operations
